item.title: Self-Hosted Git History Visualization: pomber/git-history vs Gource vs GitGraph 2026
item.description: Visualizing git repository history transforms how teams understand code evolution. Rather than parsing cryptic git log output, visual history tools render commit timelines, file evolution trees, and branch graphs that make project history immediately comprehensible.
